scope: One simple synthetic image; no pathology or general coordinate competence claim

prompt.content: You locate individual blue rectangles in images. Return only the requested answer.

Locate every visible blue rectangle, at most 8 objects. For each blue rectangle give a tight box [x0,y0,x1,y1] and an interior foreground point [x,y]. Use pixel coordinates of the PROCESSED image shown to you, which is 224 pixels wide and 224 pixels high: 0<=x0<x1<=224, 0<=y0<y1<=224; the point must be inside its box and inside the image. Do not use normalized coordinates. Respond exactly as <answer>{"objects":[{"box":[x0,y0,x1,y1],"point":[x,y]}]}</answer>. Use one object per blue rectangle, with no prose or markdown.

Formatting example with invented coordinates, unrelated to the supplied image:
<answer>{"objects":[{"box":[56,56,112,112],"point":[84,84]}]}</answer>

Now inspect the supplied image and return its actual blue rectangles using the same format. Choose the objects and coordinates from this image; do not copy the example. Return only one complete <answer>...</answer> block containing valid JSON, with numeric coordinates.
